one_month_reasoning: No earnings in the window: CEG has reported Q3 in early November each year (Nov 2022-2025 8-Ks) and no new 8-K or date announcement appears on EDGAR through 2026-09-30, so Q3 most likely lands just after 2026-10-29. Inside the window: PJM Reliability Backstop Procurement bids close Oct 21 (results not until ~Dec 2), the Oct 27-28 FOMC after a September hike to a 4.00% upper bound with the 10y at 5.24% (FRED), possible FERC orders on PJM large-load tariffs, and possible unscheduled PPA announcements. Rates are a mild headwind, the post-selloff rebound from $254.71 a mild tailwind; net I take no directional view: centred at ~$265 with monthly sigma ~12.9% (47%/3.5, trimmed slightly).

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E on 2028E total adjusted EPS ($13.8 x 19x = $262), 2028 FCF before growth ($17.0/share at a 6.75% yield = $252) and base-EPS multiple ($9.45 x 28x = $265), weighted 0.45/0.35/0.20 = $259, plus ~$1.7 dividends, rounded to $262 for Sept 2027. Down from $280 mainly because the 10y is 5.24%, not ~4.5%.

Rates above 5% and the June 2027 unlock of ~25M shares can plausibly take it to $210-220 without breaking the thesis, so I set the break slightly lower than in round 1.

reasoning: Round 2. The supervisor confirmed my primary-document work (base/enhanced split, dated lock-up) but showed my FCF-yield leg rested on a ~4.5% 10y; FRED shows 5.24% on 2026-09-28 and the Fed funds upper bound at 4.00% after a 9/17 hike, which I verified directly. Re-running at a 6.75% FCF yield (~150bp over the 10y) drops that leg from $280 to $252; I also trim the P/E to 19x and the base-EPS multiple to 28x for the same reason. I partly accept the supervisor's $14.2 framework 2028E, moving from $13.5 to $13.8 while keeping a small ERCOT/enhanced haircut, because consensus 2027 ($13.34) already sits above the framework and the Feb 2027 guide can reset it. Blended fair value falls from $280 to $262, about 1% below spot, so I no longer centre the ladder above spot. The ~25M-share unlock on 2027-06-30 (confirmed by the June 8-K and 424B4) sits inside the horizon and justifies a slightly fatter left tail. EDGAR shows no new 8-K since August (only Form 144s), so no new company news. Ladder: lognormal with median ~$263 and 42% sigma (below 47% realized, as part of recent vol was one-off supply), tails nudged up; cross-checked against scenarios $185/$270/$385 at 27/48/25%. I disagree with nothing material in the supervisor's findings; my fair value ends a little below its $272 because I use a higher FCF yield and keep an ERCOT haircut.
